basic_info.description: Remodeled single family home in Westwood Park. 5BR/4BA + family room with level, walkout yard. Fully detached 2525ft (per graphic artist) 3515ft lot. East/west exposure, great natural light.   1922 charm (built-in cabinets, decorative fireplace, bay windows) with modern upgrades  (newer windows, updated electric and plumbing, new floors, radiant heating, wine refrigerator). Attached 1 car garage + 2 car driveway parking. Finished attic space accessible via a pull down ladder. Washer/dryer closet on lower level. Main level - 2 bedroom, 2 bath, kitchen, living dining room + office (optional 5th bedroom). Lover level - master en-suite & walk-in closet + an additional bedroom and bath. Family room. Garage assess. Quick access to Glen Park, West Portal, Whole Foods, BART, 280 freeway.
